description: List open findings stored in your yof.io account: problems yof found on your proven apps' live sites and connected GitHub repositories. Use it to see what yof.io already knows; it does not scan this computer (use yof_check or yof_check_diff for that), and yof_fix_prompt takes a finding id from here. Needs YOF_API_KEY; sends only these arguments to yof.io and returns results from yof's latest checks, most recently seen first. Returns findings (id, app, rule, title, severity, where, redacted value, first and last seen) and next; an empty list means no open findings, and apps not proven yours are left out.

app_id.description: One app's id, to list only that app. Default: every proven app in the account.

limit.description: At most this many findings, 1 to 200. Default 50.

severity.description: Only this urgency: fix_now (fix today), fix_week, nice or info. Default: all.

name: yof_findings

kind.description: Kind of check that found it.

where.description: File, path or URL, and line.

note.description: Present when some apps are not proven yours.

title: Findings from your yof account
